description: The MAIRA™ Surgical Mask is carefully engineered to provide effective respiratory protection for healthcare personnel, patients, and the general public. Designed to cover the nose and mouth, it filters airborne pathogens while allowing for comfortable, normal breathing. Suitable for use in the Operating Theatre (OT), isolation settings, and public health emergencies.

technical_specifications.protection: Protects against pathogenic biological airborne particulates
technical_specifications.layer_construction: 3-Layer Protection: Outer Hydrophobic Layer, Middle Meltblown Filter Layer, Inner Soft Absorbent Layer
technical_specifications.design: Pleated design for face coverage and easy adjustment
technical_specifications.attachment_type: Strong, soft tie attachments for a secure and adjustable fit
technical_specifications.nose_clip: Integrated, flexible nose piece for improved seal
technical_specifications.comfort: Soft inner lining is gentle on the skin
technical_specifications.standard_compliance: Follows ASTM Level 2 / EN14683 Type IIR equivalent standards

benefits: Optimal Protection: Filters airborne bacteria and particulates with high efficiency

key_strengths: ASTM Level 2 / EN14683 Type IIR equivalent
